body: Fixed in 0a8f83e2d. The upstream anchor now processes a non-array (or missing) `display_gate_contract.granular_fields` as `[]` and requires the exact expected `DISPLAY_GATE_FIELDS` set (every field present, not just a matching count), so a renamed/replaced gate field fails closed with `upstream_schema_or_read_model_not_passing`. Added regression tests for both the non-array and same-length-renamed cases.
